_help: Each code gives gems to the first 'maxPlayers' players who type /redeem <code> in chat, one time per village, until 'expires' (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM). Edit this file any time: it is re-read on every /redeem, no restart needed. showGemsNow true (default) sends the home data right after a redeem so the gems show at once, without a reload; false saves them for the next load. reloadAfterRedeem true makes the game reload right after a redeem so the gems show at once; false only saves them (they show the next time the game loads).
